Rank 25 - Logistics

Warehouse and Cold Storage Receipt Manager

Storage operators need receipt, lot, owner, quantity, rent, release, and payment tracking.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 20,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 1,200Recommended monthly charge

BDT 1,200/month is possible because transaction value is higher and disputes are costly.

6.8Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 20,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 1,200Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 10,320,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Target cold storages, small warehouses, seed storage operators, and market godowns with receipt and release workflows.

Stored goods and release payments can become disputed without clean receipts.

Every stored lot has a receipt, rent, payment, and release history.

Validation signals

  • Warehouse/cold storage records are high-value.
  • Receipts reduce disputes.
  • Storage operators can pay more.
  • Partial release is a strong workflow.

MVP modules

  • Lot receipt
  • Owner/customer profile
  • Quantity
  • Storage rent
  • Partial release
  • Payment due
  • Inventory summary

Do not build first

  • Do not add IoT temperature first.
  • Do not manage financing.
  • Do not support complex WMS first.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Custom workflows.
  • Data migration.
  • Owner trust.
Mitigations
  • Start with receipt flow.
  • Charge setup.
  • Printable backups.
